attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited has released the audio recording of the earnings conference call for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call was organized on November 12, 2026, to discuss the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results. The recording is available for access via the company website at the specified investor relations link. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company previously issued an intimation regarding this event on November 06, 2026. The announcement was signed by Sundaram Balasubramanian Iyer, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "In Q2FY27, Company reports impressive growth in revenue from Operations Healthy growth seen in the Operating EBIDTA for Q2FY27 ".
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2FY27 stood at Rs. 1,273.36 million, reflecting a 28.79% year-on-year increase. Operating EBITDA was Rs. 375.41 million, and Profit After Tax was Rs. 288.87 million. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations reached Rs. 2,363.88 million, with a 22.52% year-on-year growth. Net cash from operating activities for the half year was Rs. 710.68 million. Domestic sales accounted for 64.37% of total revenue, while exports contributed 35.63%. The company introduced three new product ranges during the period. The announcement references the company's listing on stock exchanges in October 2026.

attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 1,273.36 Mn for Q2 FY27, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 28.79%. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue stood at Rs. 2,363.88 Mn, up 22.52% year-on-year. EBITDA for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 375.41 Mn, while profit after tax was Rs. 288.87 Mn. The presentation notes that the company listed on the NSE and BSE on October 21, 2026. An earnings conference call was scheduled for November 12, 2026, at 4:00 P.M. IST.

attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors held its meeting on November 12, 2026. The company completed its initial public offering comprising 2,62,84,500 equity shares at an issue price of Rs. 211 per share. The shares were listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange on October 21, 2026. The company incorporated a subsidiary in Saudi Arabia effective July 14, 2026. Statutory auditors KKC & Associates LLP issued limited review reports stating that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements in the financial results.

attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited received an order from the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Jalgaon, dated November 6, 2026. The order accepts the company's reply and drops proceedings initiated by a show cause notice dated September 29, 2026, for the financial year 2022-23. The tax authority ruled that the alleged excess availment of input tax credit was correctly availed and utilized. Consequently, the demand of Rs. 7,10,16,525, comprising tax, interest, and penalty, is dropped in its entirety. The company reports no financial or operational impact. No tax, interest, or penalty is payable pursuant to this order.
